about_the_game:
After watching 1000+ anime I decided to make a game. A game that speaks to the men who are looking for happiness.

This game is about daily life of a normal guy who wants to be happy in life. But who are truly happy in life? Very few people in this world. This is pretty much relatable to most guys out there trying to live a life. You might find some similarities with your own life too.

It has a single Japanese female character fully voiced in Japanese
So if you are an anime fan or skilled enough to understand Japanese voice lines then you will find it more interesting. If you dont understand Japanese then don't worry you will be able to read the subtitles in English like every Anime fan does.

Game will be around 2 hours long depending on your playstyle. The story might seem slow paced or fast paced time to time and ending might seem too sudden but no this is not a half heartedly made game. The ending was decided before even the game development started. So how you like the games story will depend on your mindset.

To avoid spoilers I have not included the character. Because just like anime, if its spoiled then we loose excitement.

Feel free to leave a review on your opinion on this game. I just wanted to make a game for a long time and since I don't have skills in coding or art or most of anything I decided to do make a visual novel game as it was a bit easier to do. I do hope you enjoy the game. If not then feel free to leave reviews even if its negative, I will try to improve in the future if I decide to make another game.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04+ or SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 compatible card.
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.10+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (no special GPU needed)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
